title: [LOGGED OUT] Store "Don’t have the game?" section shows the download badges

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store and wait until loaded.
steps.saw: Store page loaded (first screenshot taken mid-load showed skeleton placeholders, so the step screenshot was retaken once loaded).

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner shown at the bottom; clicked Dismiss.

steps.text: Scroll down to the "Don’t have the game? Download it today!" section.
Are the Google Play, App Store and Web-Version badges shown?
steps.saw: Three black badges shown under the heading: Google Play, App Store, Web-Version.
